title: These are common options that affect multiple checkers in the unix group.
Check for calls to blocking functions inside a critical section.
summary: Blocking functions detected by this checker: sleep, getc, fgets, read, recv. Critical section handling functions modeled by this checker: lock, unlock, pthread_mutex_lock, pthread_mutex_trylock, pthread_mutex_unlock, mtx_lock, mtx_timedlock, mtx_trylock, mtx_unlock, lock_guard, unique_lock, scoped_lock. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.BlockInCriticalSection. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check for mismatched deallocators.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.MismatchedDeallocator. It applies to C, C++.
